sources.researchNote: The printed caption reads: ‘André Haguet, metteur en scène, et André Legrand, dialoguiste du film PROCES AU VATICAN, sur le plateau de Billancourt.’ Its left-to-right order identifies Legrand as the man on the right. The media record uses a faithful crop of that figure and does not reconstruct or retouch the face.

media.title: Henri-André Legrand on the set of Procès au Vatican, 1952
media.description: Portrait detail of the screenwriter and lyricist Henri-André Legrand from a photograph published in La Cinématographie française on 23 February 1952. The printed caption names André Haguet, director, first and André Legrand, dialogue writer for Procès au Vatican, second; Legrand is therefore the man on the right.
media.altText: Halftone press portrait of Henri-André Legrand in a dark suit and tie, looking slightly upward while seated on a film set.
media.rightsNote: The photographer is not identified in the printed caption.
